name: ToastStack
shortDescription: Several toast notifications shown at the same time, the next ones waiting for a place.
description: Show several toast notifications at the same time: achievements, items found, messages... Use the action "Show a toast" as many times as needed:
- up to the maximum number of toasts, they are shown one after the other (down or up),
- then the new ones wait for a place, replace the oldest toast, or are not shown (the "When full" property),
- when a toast disappears, the other ones slide to fill its place.
Use a maximum of 1 to show only one toast at a time. "Hide all the toasts" hides them all.
The toast inside the stack gives the position and the style of every toast: edit the variant to change it.
Ready-to-use toast stacks are in the asset store [toast stacks pack](https://editor.gdevelop.io/?initial-dialog=asset-store&asset-pack=toast-stacks-toast-stacks).

propertyDescriptors.label: Maximum toasts shown
propertyDescriptors.name: MaxShownCount
propertyDescriptors.description: How many toasts can be shown at the same time. The other ones wait (or replace the oldest, see "When full").

propertyDescriptors.label: Direction
propertyDescriptors.name: Direction
propertyDescriptors.description: Down: a new toast is shown at the position of the toast of the stack, and pushes the older ones down. Up: it pushes them up.

propertyDescriptors.label: When full
propertyDescriptors.name: WhenFull
propertyDescriptors.description: What happens to a new toast when the maximum is reached: it waits for a place, it replaces the oldest toast, or it is not shown.

propertyDescriptors.label: Display duration
propertyDescriptors.name: DisplayDuration
propertyDescriptors.description: How long each toast stays visible. 0 to keep them until they are hidden with an action.

events.comment: The toast of the stack is the model of every toast: its position and its size.
In the scene editor, the model stays visible to be placed and styled.
A toast that disappeared is deleted.
The oldest waiting toast is shown when there is a place.
Each shown toast goes to its place: the newest one at the position of the model, the older ones after it. The orders are checked from the newest to the oldest.
The toasts slide to their place. They are moved by the change of their place, so that their own animation still works.

parameters: (ModelY + Toast.Variable(Rank) * (ModelHeight + Spacing) * DirectionSign - Toast.Variable(SlotY)) * min(1, 12 * TimeDelta())

events.comment: When full, the new toast waits (hidden), replaces the oldest toast, or is not shown.
The new toast is shown now if there is a place (or if it replaces the oldest one), else it waits.

eventsFunctions.description: Show a toast with a title, a message and a kind (which changes the icon). It is added to the toasts already shown, up to the maximum (then it waits, replaces the oldest toast or is not shown, see "When full").

eventsFunctions.name: HideOldest
eventsFunctions.description: Hide the oldest toast shown (the next waiting toast takes its place).

eventsFunctions.name: HideAll
eventsFunctions.description: Hide all the toasts shown, and forget the waiting ones.

eventsFunctions.name: ShownToastCount
eventsFunctions.description: the number of toasts shown (including the ones appearing or disappearing).

eventsFunctions.name: WaitingToastCount
eventsFunctions.description: the number of toasts waiting for a place to be shown.
